svg.title: Research log, March to October 2026
svg.desc: A timeline of 19 repositories created between March and October 2026, in six phases: tools first in March, applied systems in April, rigour in May, grounded and hardened in July, bounded autonomy in August, and deterministic flows in October.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: 19 repositories, in the order they were created.
